title: Basis-update and Galerkin time integration in canonical matrix-product-state form
summary: Matrix product state algorithms must enlarge their bond spaces as entanglement grows and compress them to control cost. We formulate basis-update and Galerkin (BUG) time integration as a sequence of canonical MPS sweeps for Hamiltonians represented as matrix product operators. We show when two natural basis updates produce the same trial space and when transporting coefficients between successive bases preserves the represented state.
